description: Implementation of the RenderbufferVk class for Vulkan rendering in ANGLE, managing Vulkan image resources, storage, and rendering targets.

classes.name: RenderbufferVk
classes.description: Class implementing Vulkan-specific renderbuffer functionality, including storage management and image handling.

methods.name: RenderbufferVk
methods.description: Constructor initializing the RenderbufferVk object with given state.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the renderbuffer is destroyed.

methods.name: setStorageImpl
methods.description: Sets up storage for the renderbuffer with specified parameters, creating or recreating Vulkan images as needed.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Sets storage with a default sample count of 1.

methods.name: setStorageMultisample
methods.description: Sets multisample storage, selecting appropriate sample counts based on device limits.

methods.name: setStorageEGLImageTarget
methods.description: Associates an EGL image as the storage target for the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getAttachmentRenderTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the render target associated with this renderbuffer attachment.

methods.name: initializeContents
methods.description: Initializes the contents of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: releaseOwnershipOfImage
methods.description: Releases ownership of the internal image resource.

methods.name: releaseAndDeleteImage
methods.description: Releases and deletes the internal image resource.

methods.name: getImplementationSizedFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the renderbuffer.

methods.name: getColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns the format used for reading color data.

methods.name: getColorReadType
methods.description: Returns the data type used for reading color data.

methods.name: getRenderbufferImage
methods.description: Reads pixel data from the renderbuffer image.
